snippet.title: Official Trailer | Lootbound |Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
Lootbound is a tactical loot management roguelike where you start solo and assemble your party as you go. Choose routes, risks, rewards, equip heroes and companions, and create a build to challenge the final boss. Turn-based combat, calculated risk, equipment synergies, and honest difficulty.

Learn more about Lootbound: / https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091140/Lootbound/?utm_source=yt&utm_campaign=trailerlootbound
